topic: Robin walked through Blueno's door on purpose because of the Buster Call that erased her homeland
title: Robin Walked Through Blueno's Door On Purpose
description: Nico Robin was never dragged through Blueno's door in chapter 374. I think the Buster Call that erased Ohara when she was eight is why she stepped in herself. Here's the evidence.
comment: Did Robin step through Blueno's door to protect her crew, or because Ohara taught her to leave first? Pick one.

lines.text: Nico Robin walked through Blueno's door on purpose.

shot.fallback: woman stepping through a glowing door

lines.text: In chapter 374, the escape falls apart and Robin gives herself up.
Blueno's Door Door Fruit turns anything he touches into a door.

shot.fallback: agent making a door in a wall

lines.text: But he never has to force a woman who walks in by herself.
In the anime, episode 263, Blueno brings up her past.
He talks about the Buster Call that wiped an island off the map.
That island was Ohara, and Robin was eight years old.
Here's my read: that wasn't a threat. It was a memory.
People say she was only protecting the crew.
But at Enies Lobby, in chapter 389, she tells Luffy she doesn't want to be saved.

shot.fallback: woman turning away from a boy

lines.text: Chapters 391 and 392 give the real reason: she's terrified of being a burden.
That isn't a plan. That's fear.
Ohara taught her to leave before anyone could take things from her.
A door felt like the one choice she controlled.
And that's why Nico Robin walked through Blueno's door on purpose.

shot.fallback: woman stepping through a door at dusk
